name: LeaseWeb: GPT-OSS-20B Q4 on dual EPYC 9334, ~20 tok/s decode (24t)
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (LeaseWeb blog, Fran Baigorri Hauen, 2026-04-05). HPE ProLiant DL385 Gen11, 2x EPYC 9334 (Zen4, 32c/64t each, 2.7GHz, 210W, 128MB L3/socket), 64GB DDR5 total (12-channel/socket). llama-bench (llama.cpp) local run + OpenLLM/llmperf API-level check. Test config: 512-token prompt, 128 tokens generated, 24 CPU threads for LLM rows. Values read off published charts/prose; CPU util 20-30%. Q4 gguf; 512+128 config; 24 threads.
notes: Bottom of the published 20-28 band - 20B is the largest model in the set.
